title: Netherlands: Dutch Cabinet Survives Budget Crisis but Fragility Lingers as Inflation Bites · 02 Sep
keywords: Netherlands, Dutch coalition, minority government, budget deal, inflation, cost of living, CBS, Eurostat, HICP, energy costs, Dutch politics, EU fiscal policy, eurozone, The Hague
notes: A last-minute budget agreement has kept the Dutch minority cabinet alive, but the deal has laid bare the government's dependence on opposition support and its vulnerability to future political shocks. Meanwhile, Dutch inflation rose to 3.3 percent in August, adding to persistent household pressure on energy, rent, and groceries. Together, the two developments paint a picture of a government navigating both parliamentary brinkmanship and an unresolved cost-of-living squeeze.
